product.desc:
Summer Appropriate



Made with lightweight materials, this clothing is suitable for summer use, keeping patients cool and comfortable during warmer months.






PICC Placement Friendly



The design of this clothing allows for easy access to PICC lines, making it ideal for patients with intravenous therapy needs.






Suit for Paralyzed Bedridden Elderly



This garment is perfect for paralyzed bedridden elderly, offering them the necessary support and comfort while lying down.






Easy To Wear and Remove



The easy-to-wear design of this clothing makes it convenient for patients who may have difficulty dressing themselves.






Home Wear Comfort



Ideal for home wear, this clothing provides a relaxed fit, ensuring patients can move freely while at home.

Easy to Wear



The suit is easy to put on and take off, offering convenience and efficiency in use.






Lightweight



Despite its robust construction, the suit is lightweight, providing comfort during long hours of work.






Full-Body Protection



The full-body design ensures complete protection against splashes and spills, enhancing safety in various work environments.






Corrosion Resistant



The suit offers superior corrosion resistance, making it ideal for use in environments with corrosive substances.






Acid-Base Resistant



This protective suit is designed to withstand acidic and basic environments, ensuring safety in chemical factories.

3554333689.detail_text: Customizable Design The vest's design allows for customization, making it a versatile choice for different industries and personal preferences. Versatile Use This vest is ideal for various environments, including traffic control, construction sites, and motorcycle riding, providing comprehensive safety protection. High Visibility Reflective Vest The LIKAI reflective safety vest ensures high visibility in low-light conditions, enhancing safety for construction workers and cyclists. Durable Material Made from durable materials, this vest withstands the rigors of daily use, offering long-lasting protection. Lightweight Comfort Crafted for comfort, this vest is lightweight, ensuring wearers can move freely without feeling weighed down.

aiTexts: JINLANTING Easy-to-wear Recovery Clothes are designed for post-surgery patients and individuals with limited mobility, ensuring easy dressing and undressing.
Made from durable 100% cotton material, these caregiver-friendly garments offer waterproof protection and long-lasting comfort.
The garment allows patients freedom of movement while simplifying care routines, saving time and effort for caregivers.
Suitable for various medical conditions like paralysis, stroke, dialysis, and fractures, it provides versatile support for diverse healthcare needs.

product.desc:
Comfortable Design



The comfortable design of this caregiver-friendly garment ensures that patients can move freely while still receiving the necessary care.






Caregiver-Friendly



This caregiver-friendly garment simplifies the process of dressing and undressing for caregivers, saving time and effort.






Ease of Wear



Designed for post-surgery patients, this caregiver-friendly garment allows for easy dressing and undressing, making it ideal for those with mobility issues.






Durable Material



Made from durable materials, this caregiver-friendly garment is designed to withstand frequent use while maintaining its quality and comfort.






Versatile Use



Suitable for various conditions such as paralysis, stroke, dialysis, and fractures, this garment provides versatile use for different healthcare needs.

product.highlights:
We make these coveralls extra soft without sacrificing durability.

• Heftier Ringspun Woven 7.5 oz. cotton twill
• Mechanically Pre-Shrunk – Machine Rotary Pressing process to reduce shrinkage (Shrinkage less
than 3%)
• Shoulder straps
• Two chest flap cargo pockets with pen slot
• One mobile phone holder in right pocket
• One double pens slot on left sleeve
• 2-way self-locking YKK nylon front zipper with concealed stud fastening
• Bi-swing action back for ease of movement
• This coverall has side elastic waistband for comfortable fit
• Side zipped vent
• Large front side pockets
• Two hip flap cargo pockets
• Cuffs and legs with stud fastening
• One tool/torch slot on right leg
• One cell phone pocket on left leg
• Triple Needle Stitching at crotch to guard against rips
• Bartack stitching at all stress points
• Reflective tape across chest enhances visibility
• Tested by Intertek Shanghai
• BS EN 340-2003 Approved
• Size S-38, M-40, L-42, LL-44, XL-46, 4L/2XL-48
5L/3XL-50, 6L/4XL-52

Our coveralls stay true to size and keep their vibrant colour.

product.desc:
Rechargeable Battery



Never worry about power outages with our rechargeable battery, ensuring continuous cooling whenever you need it.






Semiconductor Cooling Technology



Experience ultimate comfort with our semiconductor cooling technology, ensuring you stay cool during hot working conditions.






Men's Work Uniform



Perfect for men, this work uniform combines durability with style, making it a great addition to any professional wardrobe.






Reflective Strips Design



The reflective strips not only enhance visibility in low-light conditions but also add a stylish touch to the overall look of the vest.






Integrated Fan System



Stay refreshed with our integrated fan system that provides a cooling breeze, making it perfect for outdoor work environments.
